concerns.text: Task T013-DATA logic raises RuntimeError if <3 runs found and fallback disabled, directly contradicting FR-001 which mandates a mandatory fallback to bootstrap resampling. The task blocks the spec's required safety net.
Task T013-3RD-RUN fetches arXiv:1909.03356, a data source never mentioned in spec.md or plan.md. This violates the 'Single Source of Truth' principle and introduces unapproved scope creep.

Task T015-COV implements a block-diagonal covariance fallback (bandwidth=20) for N>200. This contradicts plan.md's 'Constitution Check' and 'Complexity Tracking' which explicitly authorize only a diagonal matrix due to lack of off-diagonal data. Block-diagonal is an unauthorized architectural assumption.

Task T030 replaces the spec-mandated 'leave-one-experiment-out cross-validation' (FR-005, US-3) with bootstrap resampling when runs < 3. The spec requires LOO as the primary method; the task silently swaps the methodology without a spec update or explicit fallback clause.

Task T038 attempts to verify SC-002 against a null-simulation baseline, but the implementation task for FR-009 (T026-NULL-SIM) is missing. T026-TEST is only a unit test. The verification step in T038 is impossible to execute, dropping a critical acceptance criterion.

Task T013-VALIDATOR implements a custom 'title-token-overlap' check. While the Constitution (Principle II) requires citation verification, the spec does not mandate this specific algorithmic implementation in the data pipeline. This risks over-constraining the implementation to a specific heuristic not defined in the FRs.
